name: listny
description: Voice dictation for any app: press a hotkey, speak, and the text is pasted where your cursor is.

scripts.check: node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/settings.cjs && node --check electron/transcribe.cjs && node --check electron/paste.cjs && node --check electron/audio.cjs && vite build

author: kaiser-data

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Listny records your voice while you dictate so it can turn it into text.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Listny pastes your dictation into the active app and mutes audio while you speak.
